newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU GRANTS 24,000 TONNES MAIZE FOOD AID TO N.KOREA.
newsitem.headline: EU GRANTS 24,000 TONNES MAIZE FOOD AID TO N.KOREA.

text.p: The European Union accepted bids to supply 24,000 tonnes of old crop maize to North Korea as food aid, European Commission officials said on Wednesday.
The officials said the maize, due to be delivered by mid-October, was priced at around 835 French francs basis Bordeaux/Bayonne August delivery.

Bids to supply 10,000 tonnes of rice food aid to North Korea had also been accepted and a new tender would be launched on August 20 to supply a further 20,000 tonnes of rice for mid-November delivery.
Details of the food aid tender awards were expected to be published on August 19.
The aid is part of a 46.3 million Ecus EU famine relief programme of rice, maize, vegetable oils and other food products to be delivered through the U.N. World Food Programme.
